verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an API-first product. It has a documented public REST API: a quickstart, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs, a Batch API and a management API. Official Python and Node SDKs and an llms.txt docs index back this up, and community users report driving it with self-serve API keys. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404).
